## Amounts, step fields and the stage fold (`RegisterMonitor::fold_`) {#sec-ch10-amounts}

<!-- PROVENANCE

### Summary

The register turns what was booked and posted in each stage into amounts per step. An amount is a named vector with
one entry per conserved row: a face correction such as the wall removal of @sec-ch10-prescribed, or a cell source
such as the implicit solve's. The stages' rates and posts are kept apart, one slot per stage, and folded with the
integrator's weights only when an amount is read. The face fluxes are folded the same way into step fields, which the
budget reads (@sec-ch10-budget).

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** The step amount of every named rate and post, @eq-ch10-fold, and the step field of every requested direction, @eq-ch10-stepfield.

**Data.** In: per-stage rates $a_s$ and posts $p_s$ $(n_{\mathrm{amount}}, n_{\mathrm{row}})$, the stage weights $w_{1,s}$, $w_{2,s}$ and $\Delta t$. Out: the step amounts $(n_{\mathrm{amount}}, n_{\mathrm{row}})$; the step fields shaped like the totals.

**Placement.** Rates and posts during the stage; `end_stage` records the weights; the fold runs at each read of `amounts`.

**Activation.** Always; a step field exists only where a reader requested it.

**Guarantee / limits.** FP64, FP32 on MPS[^rg-7722eb7d31ba]; one device fold per read, no work per stage.

**Evidence.** `test_flux_register.<b>`; `test_graph_monitor_amounts.<b>` on CUDA (Tests).
:::

Local symbols: $s = 0,\dots,S-1$ are the stages ended this step, $w_{1,s}$ and $w_{2,s}$ the integrator weights of
stage $s$ (the state after the stage is $w_{1,s}$ times the state before plus $w_{2,s}\,\Delta t$ times the stage
increment, on top of the step's start), $a_s$ a stage's booked rate, $p_s$ its weighted posts, and $S_d$ the step
field of direction $d$.

### Derivation

The integrator scales whatever a stage has already contributed by the later stages' $w_1$. A rate booked in stage
$s$ enters the step with $w_{2,s}\,\Delta t$ and is then scaled by every later stage's $w_1$. A post already carries
its weight. The step amount is therefore

$$
A = \sum_{s} c_s\,\bigl(w_{2,s}\,\Delta t\,a_s + p_s\bigr), \qquad c_s = \prod_{t>s} w_{1,t},
$$ {#eq-ch10-fold}

with the product over the stages ended this step. The step field is the same recursion applied to the totals at
every `end_stage`,

$$
S_d \leftarrow w_{1,s}\,S_d + w_{2,s}\,\Delta t\,T_d ,
$$ {#eq-ch10-stepfield}

which unrolls to $S_d = \sum_s c_s\,w_{2,s}\,\Delta t\,T_{d,s}$, the same weights as @eq-ch10-fold. A split post
outside the stages adds to a direct part of $S_d$ that no $w_1$ scales.

### Numerical method

**Names and kinds.** `reset_amounts` creates three amounts, `reconcile.x1`, `reconcile.panel` and
`boundary.prescribed`, all of kind `flux_correction`, with one stage slot until the stage count is set
({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp RegisterMonitor::reset_amounts >}}). A cell amount is created at its first
post with the kind it is posted with; another kind for the same name throws
({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp RegisterMonitor::post >}}). The kinds say how the budget is to treat an amount
({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.hpp AmountKind >}}). At the pin the cell amounts are the implicit solve's
`vic.cell` (cell source), `vic.mass_clamped` (flux correction) and `vic.momentum_t.top` (diagnostic)
({{< code src/implicit/implicit_hydro.cpp ImplicitHydroImpl::post_ >}}) and the axial-momentum fixer's
`aam.closure` (fixer) ({{< code src/forcing/axial_momentum.cpp AxialClosureFixer::apply >}}).

**Rates and posts.** `book` adds a rate to the current stage's rate slot; `book_index` does the same by index, for
the wall batch ({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp RegisterMonitor::book >}}). `cell_amount` sums a cell
change over the cells in the wide dtype and posts it with its stage weight, $w_{2,s}$ for a change to the stage
increment, 1 for a change already in the state ({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp FluxRegister::cell_amount >}}).
Both a post inside a stage and one after the combine land in the stage's post slot.

**Stage slots.** `MeshBlockImpl::reset` sizes the slots for the integrator's stages before the executor's save list
is taken ({{< code src/mesh/meshblock.cpp MeshBlockImpl::reset >}}); a later stage index grows them, eagerly
({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp RegisterMonitor::set_stage_count >}}). `FluxRegister::begin_stage` selects the
slot ({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp FluxRegister::begin_stage >}}). `RegisterMonitor::end_stage` reduces the
stage's counts (@sec-ch10-counts), records $w_{1,s}$ and $w_{2,s}\Delta t$, and launches nothing else
({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp RegisterMonitor::end_stage >}}). $w_{2,s}\Delta t$ is a `StepDt`, on the device
in a captured stage ({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp FluxRegister::end_stage >}}).

**The fold.** `fold_` computes @eq-ch10-fold over the stages ended so far
({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp RegisterMonitor::fold_ >}}). It forms the $c_s$[^rg-8ab0796952e7] on the host from the recorded
$w_1$, folds the post slots of the ended stages and of the stage still open, which count at once with $c = 1$, and
adds the rate slots of the ended stages times $c_s\,w_{2,s}\Delta t$. The rates of a stage still open wait for its
$w_{2,s}\Delta t$. The result is written into the step-amount tensor. `amounts(name)` runs the fold and returns one
row of it ({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp RegisterMonitor::amounts >}}).

**Precision and place.** The slots are created in FP64 and moved to the register's device in the device's wide
dtype, FP64 or FP32 on MPS, cast on the host before the move
({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp RegisterMonitor::place_amounts >}},
{{< code src/mesh/precision_policy.hpp PrecisionPolicy::wide >}}). They are registered with the state store as
`freg.amount.rate`, `freg.amount.post` and `freg.amount.step`, so a warm-up or capture pass restores them
({{< code src/mesh/meshblock.cpp MeshBlockImpl::register_flux_storage >}}).

**Step fields.** A reader asks for $S_d$ with `request_step_field` and it exists from the next `begin_step`, in the
wide dtype ({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp FluxRegister::begin_attempt_ >}}). `FluxRegister::end_stage` applies
@eq-ch10-stepfield ({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp FluxRegister::end_stage >}}). `post_split` adds a split
source's half-step flux to a direct part, refused inside a stage
({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp FluxRegister::post_split >}}). The budget output requests every active
direction (@sec-ch10-budget); radial conduction requests $x_1$ ({{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::reset >}}).

### Tests

| test (ctest name) | what it asserts | tolerance | where the tolerance comes from |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_flux_register.<b>` (`amounts_fold_like_the_step_field`) | over three steps of seam overwrites, `reconcile.x1` equals @eq-ch10-fold computed by hand; after a rollback it is zero | $10^{-15}$ relative; exact zero | set inline ({{< code tests/test_flux_register.cpp FluxRegister.amounts_fold_like_the_step_field >}}) |
| `test_flux_register.<b>` (`step_field_recursion_equals_the_weighted_stage_sum`) | the step field is FP64 and equals the weighted stage sum | $10^{-15}$ relative | set inline ({{< code tests/test_flux_register.cpp FluxRegister.step_field_recursion_equals_the_weighted_stage_sum >}}) |
| `test_flux_register.<b>` (`cell_amounts_fold_with_their_stage_weight`) | cell posts with $w_{2,s}$ and after-combine posts with 1 fold as @eq-ch10-fold | $10^{-15}$ relative | set inline ({{< code tests/test_flux_register.cpp FluxRegister.cell_amounts_fold_with_their_stage_weight >}}) |
| `test_flux_register.<b>` (`cell_amount_names_are_made_at_their_first_post`, `the_amounts_are_three_flux_corrections`) | the names, kinds, shapes and FP64 dtype; a second kind or a wrong shape throws | exact | ({{< code tests/test_flux_register.cpp FluxRegister.cell_amount_names_are_made_at_their_first_post >}}) |
| `test_flux_register.<b>` (`post_split_is_never_scaled_by_a_later_w1`) | $S_d$ is the plain recursion plus the direct part; split posts are refused inside a stage | exact | ({{< code tests/test_flux_register.cpp FluxRegister.post_split_is_never_scaled_by_a_later_w1 >}}) |
| `test_graph_monitor_amounts.<b>` (`monitor_amounts_match_eager_bitwise`) | ten steps at a new dt each: every amount of a captured block equals the eager block's; one capture per stage | exact | graph must equal eager ({{< code tests/test_graph_monitor_amounts.cpp GraphSaveList.monitor_amounts_match_eager_bitwise >}}); CUDA only |

: Tests of the amounts and step fields. {#tbl-ch10-amounts-tests}

The `test_flux_register` cases pass at the pin, on CPU. The two fold tests print their worst relative difference
from @eq-ch10-fold: 0 for `reconcile.x1` and $2.2\times10^{-16}$ for the cell amounts, lines `G-R14` of the run
record of @tbl-ch10-ctest-run. The graph case skips without CUDA and was not run here.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
- On MPS the amounts and step fields are FP32, because the device holds no FP64. No test in this chapter runs them
  on MPS.
:::

1. **The fold is per read.** Every call of `amounts` folds all slots again and overwrites the step-amount tensor; a
   reader that wants several names pays one fold per name.
